description: React component for rendering and managing a chart container within a dashboard grid, including resize, full-size toggle, outline highlighting, and drag-and-drop functionality.

methods.name: handleDeleteComponent
methods.description: Deletes the chart component from the dashboard.

methods.name: handleUpdateSliceName
methods.description: Updates the slice name override for the chart component.

methods.name: handleToggleFullSize
methods.description: Toggles the chart between full size and embedded view.

methods.name: handleExtraControl
methods.description: Sets additional control values for the chart.

methods.name: renderChild
methods.description: Renders the chart component within a resizable container, including controls and styling.
